_comment: PLACEHOLDER google-services.json — replace before shipping. Firebase Console → Project Settings → Your apps → Android app (package michel.kit.us) → Download google-services.json. Without a real file, FirebaseApp.initializeApp() will still succeed (the google-services Gradle plugin generates valid resources from these placeholder values) but every Firebase backend call (FCM token fetch, sign-in, etc.) will fail at runtime with an authentication error. The build, however, will pass — Phase B Round 2's APK can ship for non-push validation.
